summary: Vertical (9:16) video editor: raw take in, finished short out, in the Pipecorn vertical language (headlines at the top passing behind you, paper plates in stop-motion, the SFX pack, -14 LUFS), with an old-radio hook offered every time.

prerequisites.label: Node.js and npm (the skills' scripts, in Claude Code)
Rendering engine (node packages)
prerequisites.hint: Installed on first run by scripts/bootstrap.mjs.

prerequisites.label: Speech-to-text (Whisper, on your Mac's GPU)
prerequisites.hint: Installed on first run by scripts/bootstrap.mjs.

prerequisites.label: Music shelf (4 Mixkit tracks + 2 of the sound pack)
prerequisites.hint: The Mixkit tracks download from mixkit.co on first run; the other two come with the app's sound pack (not Mixkit: fine in a video, they can block its monetisation).

prerequisites.label: SFX pack (flash, click, whoosh, glitch, riser)
prerequisites.hint: Kept in the shelf; init.sh copies it into every project.

prerequisites.label: Swift compiler (the person matte: text behind the speaker)
GEMINI_API_KEY (only when a plan needs a generated picture)
prerequisites.hint: Most edits need no generated image.
prerequisites.does: Makes a picture when an edit needs one that you don't have (Nano Banana 2).
prerequisites.without: The edit uses your own pictures and logos. Most edits need no generated picture.
prerequisites.cost: About $0.07 a picture, billed by Google.

prerequisites.label: ELEVENLABS_API_KEY (your voice made better, a bonus)
prerequisites.hint: Your own ElevenLabs key: in the app, Settings › Connectors › Add key. Only for the bonus « Your voice made better » (ElevenLabs' voice isolator: the room's echo and the noise out of your take), billed by ElevenLabs per minute of sound.
prerequisites.offer: Your voice can be made better (the room's echo and the noise taken out) with an ElevenLabs key. Without one, the take's own sound is used.
